sections.heading: 1. Set up the kitchen
lines: ① Long chopping? A thick board raises the work.
② Peel and prep sitting at the table.
③ One foot on a low shelf, swap every few min.
④ Roast tray close to your body, turn your feet.

slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice
items: No easing after a few days

caption:
Cooking for twelve this Christmas? Your back might feel it before the pudding comes out. 🎄

Long stretches at the bench, low ovens and heavy roasting trays add up. It's rarely one lift that does it. More often it's hours in the same position.

Hybi's kitchen kit: raise the work with a thick board, peel and prep sitting at the table, rest one foot on a low shelf and swap sides, and lift trays close to your body while turning with your feet. Cook in 20 to 30 minute rounds with a short walk in between.

Pain spreading down a leg, or a flare-up that isn't settling after a few days, is worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
